items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.117 fixes MCP approval leakage
facts: Approving an MCP server's tools for the session or for a location no longer also approves Copilot's built-in requests, such as shell commands or memory stores, when the server's name matches a built-in permission type.
The approval still covers that server's tools, including after the session is resumed.
Added sandbox.userPolicy.network.extraCaCertificates to trust custom CA certificates for sandboxed commands through TLS-intercepting proxies.

items.title: Antigravity CLI 1.5.18 resolves file:/// permission gaps and image handling
facts: Fixed the agent attaching truncated or corrupt images to the conversation when viewing files; it now rejects them with an error, so a half-written image no longer makes later model requests fail and retry.
Fixed file permission rules and approval prompts not applying to files the agent reads or edits through file:/// URIs; those paths now resolve to the real file before permissions are checked.
Fixed plugins not loading on Windows when your workspace is on a different drive than your Antigravity configuration directory.

items.title: OpenCode 2.4.2 limits Always allow web fetches and adds GPT-6.2 prompts
facts: "Always allow" for a web fetch allows that site only. It used to allow every URL.
GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, and the gpt-latest aliases, use a system prompt written for GPT-6.2.
generate_image and generate_video run inside Code Mode instead of as top-level tools, so their definitions no longer add about 700 tokens to every request.

items.title: Pydantic launches Pax, a plugin-first terminal coding agent
facts: Pax is the official Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal, built on the Harness SDK.
Everything in Pax is a plugin, including the coding agent itself.
You can run your own Pydantic AI agent with pax --agent.

items.title: enhance-qa brings independent QA teams inside coding agents
facts: A scout maps every screen and control and writes the test checklist.
Only the fixer touches your code. Nobody grades their own work.
Works with Claude Code and Codex, plus Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and Antigravity.

items.title: Community highlights Claude Code /ship and steward PR repair loops
facts: /code-review before the PR. add --fix and it repairs what it finds.
/ship when the change is done. opens the PR, reviews it, then keeps watching.
/steward 41 for a PR that already exists. starts the watch, skips the opening review.

items.title: Developers share Grok Bot workflows that hire Cursor cloud agents
facts: Grok Bot can now hire Cursor agents as its own developers.
Cloud Agents must be on in Cursor and your repo connected.
Never merge without my OK.

items.title: Real Python publishes guide on GitHub Copilot CLI autonomy and /yolo
facts: How much should GitHub Copilot CLI, the coding agent in your terminal, do without asking you first?
Do you approve every command a coding agent runs, or turn on /yolo?

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.332 adds beta MCP server skills and PreSkillShellCommand hook
facts: Added skills from MCP servers (beta). They show as server:skill in the / menu; other skills keep their names.
Added a PreSkillShellCommand hook event that can refuse a skill or command's inline shell commands as it loads.
